Professional Video Generator Free 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Instantly generate and export professional videos from raw footage using cloud AI processing.
- Supports uploads up to 500MB (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, and more); ideal for freelancers and content creators.
- Simple setup: automatic token generation and seamless connection to backend.
- Handles common editing instructions (titles, transitions, aspect ratio, audio tracks) via natural language prompts.
- Transparent credit tracking, session management, and error handling.
- Quick turnaround: typical 1-2 minute processing for short clips, export as 1080p MP4.
